Riftlet 1.0.2 改善截图附加、异常恢复和日常设置。
- 修复动态附件菜单可能选到无关文件输入框的问题，改进点击截图时的目标确认。 - 修复附加尚未开始就退出后截图滞留的问题。结果不确定的操作继续保留，避免自动重复附加。 - 外观偏好损坏时保留原文件并继续启动，恢复截图收录和历史访问。 - 设置整理为「通用」「桌面」「截图」「帮助」四页，常用更新和权限入口更容易找到，编辑中的文字与输入法组字受到保护。 - 改善中英文引导、菜单栏状态和历史界面，修复英文控制中心标题拥挤的问题。 - 减少大量历史记录下的重复读取，改善启动和历史刷新响应。
使用 1.0.1 时，可从菜单栏选择「检查更新…」，阅读说明后决定安装。Riftlet 会正常退出并重新打开，保留截图、历史和设置。使用 1.0.0 或更早版本时，请先退出 App，再将下载包中的 Riftlet.app 拖到原安装位置并选择替换一次。
支持 macOS 13 及以上的 Apple 芯片和 Intel Mac。截图附加适用于 Google Chrome 中可编辑的 ChatGPT 网页草稿，需要截图文件夹访问权限、macOS 的 Chrome 自动化授权，以及 Chrome「显示 → 开发者 → 允许 Apple 事件中的 JavaScript」。点击微图后图片交给当前草稿，消息由你发送。
[下载 Riftlet 1.0.2](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/releases/download/v1.0.2/Riftlet-1.0.2.dmg) · [安装与权限](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/blob/main/docs/consumer/INSTALL-AND-PERMISSIONS.md) · [支持与验收范围](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/blob/main/docs/consumer/SUPPORT-MATRIX.md)
隐私联系 [privacy@riftlet.com](mailto:privacy@riftlet.com)
Riftlet 1.0.2 improves screenshot attachment, recovery and everyday settings.
- Fixes a case where a dynamic attachment menu could select an unrelated file input, and improves target checks when a screenshot is clicked. - Restores screenshots that became stuck after the app quit before attachment began. Operations with an uncertain result remain recorded to avoid automatic duplicate uploads. - Keeps the original file when appearance preferences are damaged and allows screenshot collection and history to start. - Organizes Settings into General, Desktop, Screenshots and Help. Update and permission controls are easier to find, and text being edited, including input-method composition, is preserved. - Improves English and Simplified Chinese setup, menu bar status and history, and fixes crowded English titles in the control center. - Reduces repeated reads with large histories to improve startup and history refresh responsiveness.
If you use 1.0.1, choose Check for Updates from the menu bar and decide whether to install after reading the notes. Riftlet quits normally, reopens and preserves screenshots, history and settings. If you use 1.0.0 or earlier, quit the app, then drag the downloaded Riftlet.app to its existing installation location and choose Replace once.
Supports macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon and Intel. Screenshot attachments work in editable ChatGPT web drafts in Google Chrome. Allow access to the screenshot folder, grant macOS permission to automate Chrome, and enable View → Developer → Allow JavaScript from Apple Events in Chrome. Clicking a thumbnail hands that image to the current draft. You send the message yourself.
[Download Riftlet 1.0.2](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/releases/download/v1.0.2/Riftlet-1.0.2.dmg) · [Installation and permissions](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/blob/main/docs/consumer/INSTALL-AND-PERMISSIONS.md) · [Support and acceptance coverage](https://github.com/haohongfei2001-png/Riftlet/blob/main/docs/consumer/SUPPORT-MATRIX.md)
Privacy contact [privacy@riftlet.com](mailto:privacy@riftlet.com)
